title: No-copy immutable adaptive representation ownership
motivation: F-AHL28 measured warm bind/cache-hit cost at 31.0722 percent of a 16-head adaptive constitutive evaluation, and code authority shows cache-hit intrinsic assignment deep-copies allocatable representation arrays.

repair.cache_ownership: shared cache owns one immutable allocated representation target per exact key
repair.provider_ownership: provider borrows a pointer/reference to the immutable cached representation
repair.cache_hit: pointer association only; no support-array copy or allocation
repair.cache_miss: allocate cache-owned representation once, build directly into it, publish entry only after successful build
repair.step_dependent_state: analytical fallback provider remains rebound per step_duration exactly as before

frozen_semantics: same exact cache key and fingerprint policy
same derivative-consistent builder and support arrays
same dry-tail C=1e-13 relevance bound and analytical fallback
same qbot and accepted-trajectory analytical fallbacks

qualification.microbenchmark: warm bind cost must materially decrease relative to F-AHL28 baseline

decision_rule: Retain repair only if all frozen semantics/regressions pass and warm bind cost decreases by at least 50 percent relative to 5.6449e-7 seconds. Application timing is measured separately and is not required to accept the lifecycle repair itself.
